Instead, it had the capabilities and techniques usually associated with advanced persistent threats (APTs). Based on the techniques used in this attack, it appears to be another campaign launched by APT34. The rest of this blog will analyze the attack chain associated with this email and the traits that set it apart from average malware, such as DNS tunneling and stateful programming.
